topic: localbusiness structured data (schema) tells google your hours and address
hook: Your opening hours are on your site. Google still can't read them.
caption:
Comment LEARN and I'll send you my free SEO starter guide. Follow for one SEO and web design lesson a day.

Google reads the words. It guesses the meaning.

Structured data removes the guess: a small block of LocalBusiness code that says this is a business in Denver, here's the phone, it opens at 7 on Monday and closes at 6 on Friday.

Test it free in Google's Rich Results Test.

One honest note, straight from Google Search Central: there's no promise the extra details will show up in results. It just helps Google understand you.
